qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive local branch network and urgent replacement parts distribution for refrigeration/HVAC installers create route density and switching barriers. F-Gas environmental regulations and heat-pump transitions provide structural pricing power.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in commercial refrigeration and HVAC wholesale distribution. Critical, urgent replacement parts support pricing power. Strong secular tailwind from EU/US environmental refrigerant phase-downs (F-Gas). Low leverage with net debt 0.41x net income and 7.1x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: organic volume 3.5% + pricing power 1.5% + margin expansion 0.5% + bolt-on M&A 3.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 13.0% and operating tangible ROIC is 42.9%. FY2025 Owner FCF reached SEK 3,788M on Net Income of SEK 2,326M (multi-year FCF conversion 93.9%). Record EBITA margin of 10.7% in 2025. Rapid post-Heritage acquisition deleveraging brought net debt down to SEK 965M (0.41x net income) with interest coverage of 7.1x.
